race.description: Garrard's Horse & Hound Australia And Nz Wide Ms Pace
race.comment: Two WA fan favourites resume their long-running rivalry here but it is MINSTREL NZ (4) who gets the best of the draw. Hasn't raced since a midfield finish in the Nullarbor in April but he is a five-time fresh winner with impressive records here and at the distance. He should get every chance for a winning return. MAGNIFICENT STORM NZ (8) resumes from a spell of ten weeks and while drawn deep he came from similar barriers to win each of his three starts here last time in. Has a great fresh record with seven wins and four placings from 12 tries and can never be discounted. WE WALK BY FAITH (10) tackles a couple of smart ones tonight but he has the fitness edge and has done a good job in winning three of his four starts here since crossing from NZ. GOLDEN LODE NZ (11) tends to improve into his campaigns so looking for better second-up tonight.
